# @brand/ai

> ChatShell, Conversation, Message, PromptInput, Tool, Reasoning, citations.

Import from `@brand/ai`. Part of brand-ui — see the root `llms.txt` for routing.

## Agent output contract (what shape to emit)

- Conversation → ai/UIMessage (shipped). Parts: text, reasoning, tool, source-url; rendered by Conversation, Message, Tool, Reasoning, Sources. Your app owns useChat (D5).
- Ad-hoc JSX → JSXPreview (shipped); renders only tags present in the components allow-list.
- A2UI → not-shipped (WP-11); not usable yet.
- Tool state → Status: input-streaming=pending, input-available=running, approval-requested=awaiting-approval, approval-responded=running, output-available=complete, output-denied=denied, output-error=failed.
